description.value:
Source: Arcforge Players Compendium

Technomancers supplement unusual technologies with magic and ritual, restoring function and pattern where mechanical knowledge is sparse.

Class Skills: Disable Device (Dex), Disguise (Cha), Knowledge (engineering) (Int)

Path Benefit: The technomancer gains either the Technomancy Sphere or the Tinker sphere as a bonus talent.

Path Power: The technomancer can channel either positive or negative energy (chosen when she uses this ability) a number of times per day equal to 3 + her casting ability modifier. When a technomancer channels energy to heal or harm living creatures, she instead heals or harms constructs with the clockwork or robot subtypes. Constructs without those subtypes are also affected, but gain only half the normal amount of healing or take only half the normal amount of damage, as appropriate. The technomancer can take other feats to add to this ability, such as Extra Channel and Improved Channel, but not feats that alter this ability, such as Elemental Channel and Alignment Channel. The DC to save against this channeled energy is equal to 10 + 1/2 the technomancer’s level + the technomancer’s casting ability modifier.

Path Secrets: A hedgewitch with the technomancy path adds the following secrets to those she may select:

  • Applied Learning (Ex): When a technomancer succeeds at a saving throw against a technological effect that has reduced effects on a successful save, she instead avoids the effect entirely. A helpless or flat-footed technomancer does not benefit from this ability.
  • Enforce Reliability (Su): As a free action, the technomancer may spend a spell point to prevent a piece of technological equipment they are holding from glitching for 1 round.
  • Recondition {Su): Through constant maintenance, a technomancer can keep a single piece of still-functioning timeworn technology in good working order. Reconditioning a timeworn technological item takes 8 hours, after which the item no longer has a chance of glitching when used by the technomancer and can be recharged normally by the technomancer but no one else. Keeping the item working requires 1 hour of maintenance each day, or the item reverts to a normal piece of timeworn technology and must be reconditioned again. At 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter, a technomancer can keep an additional item in good working order, without increasing her daily maintenance time.
  • Study Technology (Ex): a technomancer can study a construct, technological object, or technological trap within 30 feet as a move action and attempt a Knowledge (engineering) check to identify it. If she succeeds, she gains a +1 competence bonus on attack rolls, combat maneuver checks, saving throws, and skill checks involving the studied creature, object, or trap, as well as a dodge bonus of the same amount against attacks from the subject of her study. This bonus lasts a number of rounds equal to her casting ability modifier (minimum 1) and increases by 1 at 5th level and every 4 hedgewitch levels thereafter. If the technomancer studies a new subject, she loses her bonus against the previous subject.

Path Grand Secrets: A hedgewitch with the technomancy path adds the following grand secrets to those she may select:

  • Glitch Mastery (Su): whenever a technomancer triggers a glitch when using a timeworn technological item, she rolls twice and can choose which of the two glitch effects actually occurs. A technomancer always adds her level to rolls to determine what kind of glitch occurs, and treats rolls of over 100 as 100.
  • Unified Energy (Su): As part of using an ability that would require the expenditure of spell points, the technomancer may substitute charges from a technological item she is holding for spell points at a rate of 5 charges per spell point.

Path Mastery: As a full-round action, the technomancer may activate a piece of technological equipment which could normally be activated as a standard action, and use a magic sphere effect which could be used as a standard action or shorter as part of the same action.

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
